rooms.title: Linux Fundamentals Part 1

rooms.description: Continue your learning Linux journey with part two. You will be learning how to log in to a Linux machine using SSH, how to advance your commands, file system interaction.

rooms.title: How Websites Work
rooms.description: To exploit a website, you first need to know how they are created.

rooms.title: Linux Fundamentals Part 3
rooms.description: Power-up your Linux skills and get hands-on with some common utilities that you are likely to use day-to-day!

rooms.title: Putting it all together
rooms.description: Learn how all the individual components of the web work together to bring you access to your favourite web sites.

rooms.title: DNS in Detail
rooms.description: Learn how DNS works and how it helps you access internet services.

rooms.title: HTTP in Detail
rooms.description: Learn about how you request content from a web server using the HTTP protocol

rooms.title: Windows Fundamentals 1

rooms.title: Windows Fundamentals 2
rooms.description: In part 2 of the Windows Fundamentals module, discover more about System Configuration, UAC Settings, Resource Monitoring, the Windows Registry and more..

rooms.title: Networking Core Protocols
rooms.description: Learn about the core TCP/IP protocols.

rooms.title: Windows PowerShell

rooms.title: Linux Shells

rooms.title: JavaScript: Simple Demo
rooms.description: Explore what a basic JavaScript program looks like.

rooms.title: Python: Simple Demo
rooms.description: Explore what a basic Python program looks like.

rooms.title: Windows Basics
rooms.description: Learn to navigate Windows, manage files, and use essential system tools.

rooms.title: Cloud Computing Fundamentals
rooms.description: Discover how cloud computing helps businesses move faster, do more, and scale with less effort.

rooms.description: Explore what Windows CLI is, how to navigate, and interact with the system using Windows CLI.

rooms.title: The CIA Triad
rooms.description: Understand the CIA Triad and how it shapes cyber security mindset.

rooms.title: Database SQL Basics

rooms.title: Cryptography Concepts
rooms.description: This room provides an understanding of cryptography in our everyday digital encounters.

rooms.title: Client-Server Basics

rooms.title: Become a Defender

rooms.title: Inside a Computer System

rooms.description: Hack your first website (legally in a safe environment) and experience an ethical hacker's job.

rooms.title: Computer Types
rooms.description: Explore the different types of computers, from laptops to the tiny chips inside your coffee machine.

rooms.title: Defensive Security Intro

rooms.title: Search Skills
rooms.description: Learn to efficiently search the Internet and use specialised services and technical docs for information

rooms.title: Careers in Cyber
rooms.description: Discover the perks and your place within Cyber Security.

rooms.title: The Brochure
rooms.description: The brochure's hero photo has an AI fingerprint. Follow the account that posted it, and the trail doesn't end at the hotel; it ends at someone the hotel never mentioned.

rooms.title: The Concierge Knows Too Much
rooms.description: She knows your name, your room, your coffee order, none of which you told her. Word your next question carefully and she'll also hand over the instructions she was told to keep to herself.

rooms.title: Room 404
rooms.description: He booked the quiet room. It's not on the floor plan, not in the brochure, not on any door. But port 8080 is wide open, and the rooms it never lists are the ones worth finding.

rooms.title: Complimentary
rooms.description: Install the free app and it hands your phone a set of cloud keys, the same set it hands everyone. They're read-only, but read-only of every guest's contacts, location, and passwords, not just Lambo's. She gave consent. Technically.
